title: THE PROCESS
objective: Analyze the suspicious utility binary to identify the control flow and authorization code.
technicalMechanism: Static string inspection reveals decoy strings. Disassembly or GDB analysis of validate_code reveals the code format: length 14, 'NX-' prefix, '-TRIAGE' suffix, and digit sum of 15. The flag is constructed in memory at runtime.
hintLevels: Running strings process_triage reveals several decoy flags. Inspect the binary in GDB, Ghidra, or objdump to locate the true validation function validate_code.
Examine validate_code: it checks that the input is 14 characters long, starts with 'NX-', ends with '-TRIAGE', and that the middle 4 digits sum to 15.
Pass a valid authorization code such as 'NX-7701-TRIAGE' to execute the success branch and reveal the forensic token.

title: GHOST.EXE
objective: Reverse engineer the custom rolling XOR transformation in ghost_loader to recover the activation key.
technicalMechanism: The binary validates a 15-character key using a rolling XOR transformation: key[i] ^ (0x5A + (i * 7)). Reversing this byte check reveals the key 'ECHO-GHOST-2018', which triggers runtime payload decryption.
hintLevels: Decompile or disassemble validate_ghost_key. Note the loop iterating over 15 characters, applying an XOR mask of (0x5A + (i * 7)) & 0xFF.
Extract expected_key_enc from the binary and XOR each byte with (0x5A + (i * 7)) & 0xFF to reconstruct the original key string.
Execute ./ghost_loader ECHO-GHOST-2018 to decrypt the payload buffer and retrieve the output key.

title: AURELIA MODULE
objective: Reverse the bitwise rotation and XOR matrix transformation in aurelia_validator to reconstruct a valid license.
technicalMechanism: The validator applies 3-bit left bitwise rotation and XOR with a linear constant sequence: ((val << 3) | (val >> 5)) ^ ((i * 13 + 0x47) & 0xFF). Solvers invert this transformation over target_state bytes to recover 'AURA-9921-ECHO-8842'.
hintLevels: Analyze check_aurelia_license. For each character index i, it rotates the character 3 bits left and XORs with ((i * 13 + 0x47) & 0xFF).
Invert the transformation: XOR target_state[i] with ((i * 13 + 0x47) & 0xFF), then rotate 3 bits right (((x >> 3) | (x << 5)) & 0xFF) to recover each byte.
Provide the recovered key 'AURA-9921-ECHO-8842' to aurelia_validator to output the security token.

title: UNKNOWN
objective: Perform multi-stage state machine and indirect function call analysis to trigger the bridge handoff sequence.
technicalMechanism: The binary dispatches through a function pointer array (dispatch_table) enforcing a 3-stage state machine. It requires specific command line flags --bridge-mode=legacy and --key=ECHO-HANDSHAKE-0x99 to advance through states and execute state_render.
hintLevels: Examine the main function in GDB or Ghidra. Notice that execution branches through dispatch_table function pointers dependent on ctx.state.
Inspect state_init (first table entry) to determine expected command line arguments: --bridge-mode=legacy and --key=ECHO-HANDSHAKE-0x99.
Execute ./nexus_bridge --bridge-mode=legacy --key=ECHO-HANDSHAKE-0x99 to complete the 3-stage handoff and output the bridge vector.
